integrity: Analytic finite-state coupling proof with an exhaustive small-n rational verifier; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform recursive trees only; stochastic order of nonroot offspring vectors and leaf sets conditional on root outdegree, not whole-tree stochastic order. Historical-priority risk remains because general stochastic covering could imply a related coupling.
title: Root-degree conditioning orders the nonroot offspring vector in uniform random recursive trees
